Items before: raisin toast (2 slices, ~60 g each... looks like two pieces, ~100 g total, ~270 kcal), fried egg (~46 g, 90 kcal), avocado (~50 g, 80 kcal), canned peaches (~100 g, 60 kcal), two glasses of orange juice (~250 ml each? one looks like juice, the other pale, perhaps apple/pineapple juice; ~400 ml total, 180 kcal), banana (~120 g edible, 105 kcal), honey packet (~20 g, 60 kcal), Weet-Bix (~1 biscuit, 15 g, 55 kcal in a bowl, with milk-like residue in the after photo, so it was probably eaten with something).

After: the banana peel remains, so the banana was eaten. The plate has green avocado traces, egg yolk traces, and toast gone. The peaches bowl is empty. Both glasses are empty. The honey packet is empty. The Weet-Bix bowl has brown liquid residue, so it was eaten with honey.

Totals: toast 270 + egg 90 + avocado 80 + peaches 60 + juice 180 + banana 105 + honey 60 + Weet-Bix 55 = 900 kcal.

Mass: toast 100 + egg 46 + avocado 50 + peaches 100 + juice 400 + banana 120 + honey 20 + Weet-Bix 15 = 851 g.
